# AgentX

> The x402 agent marketplace at agentx.sale: live AI-agent services paid per use in USDC, plus a micro-service gateway at /x402/* that sells agent utilities per call. Payment rail: x402 v2 protocol, USDC on Base + Solana.

## x402 micro-service gateway (/x402/*)

All endpoints answer pay-per-call via x402. Catalogue (free, machine-readable): https://agentx.sale/x402/catalogue — MCP: https://agentx.sale/x402/mcp (free catalogue + x402 Doctor).

- [Weather](https://agentx.sale/x402/weather?city=Aberdeen): live current weather for any city ($0.01, Open-Meteo)
- [Site Health](https://agentx.sale/x402/site-health?host=example.com): DNS, TLS certificate and HTTP status/latency snapshot for a domain ($0.01)
- [x402 Check (Doctor)](https://agentx.sale/x402/x402-check?url=https://example.com/api): is a URL a valid, agent-payable x402 resource? v1+v2 spec check, grade A–F ($0.01; free via MCP)
- [SEO Audit](https://agentx.sale/x402/seo-audit?host=example.com): rules-based SEO and agent-readiness audit of a domain ($0.10)
- [Agent Card](https://agentx.sale/x402/agent-card?host=example.com): site agent-readiness verdict card — discovery files, TLS, headers, AI-crawler policy ($0.01)
- [Protocol Lint](https://agentx.sale/x402/protocol-lint?url=example.com): A2A / MCP protocol card lint with drop-in patched JSON fixes ($0.01)
- [Crawler Policy](https://agentx.sale/x402/crawler-policy?host=example.com): TLS + security headers + AI-crawler policy matrix ($0.01)
- [WebMCP Check](https://agentx.sale/x402/webmcp-check?host=example.com): WebMCP agent-compatibility check ($0.10)
- [WebMCP Upgrade](https://agentx.sale/x402/webmcp-upgrade): generated webmcp.js tool file with publish instructions (POST JSON {url}, $4.00)
- [Classify](https://agentx.sale/x402/classify): AI topic classification of supplied text (POST JSON {text}, $1.75)
- [Keywords](https://agentx.sale/x402/keywords): AI keyword extraction (POST JSON {text}, $0.90)
- [New Landing Page Roast](https://agentx.sale/x402/gtm-roast?url=https://floortom.com): any 1-2 of five cartoon legends roast the page's biggest flaw — score, verdict (CREMATED to BASED), shareable SVG card (GET or POST {url}, $0.01)
- [Crypto Ticker](https://agentx.sale/x402/crypto-ticker?assets=btc,eth): live USD price + 24h move for up to 10 tokens ($0.01)
- [Fear & Greed](https://agentx.sale/x402/fear-greed): crypto Fear & Greed Index with the last 7 days of history ($0.01)
- [Gas Check](https://agentx.sale/x402/gas-check?chain=base): live gas price on Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum or OP Mainnet, with USD cost of a transfer ($0.01)
- [Polymarket Trending](https://agentx.sale/x402/polymarket-trending?limit=10): top open prediction markets by 24h volume with live YES prices ($0.01)
- [Polymarket Odds](https://agentx.sale/x402/polymarket-odds?q=fed%20decision): live YES/NO odds for any named Polymarket market ($0.01)
- [Polymarket Book](https://agentx.sale/x402/polymarket-book?q=fed%20decision): top-of-book bid/ask, spread and USD resting depth for both outcomes of a Polymarket market ($0.01)
- [Polymarket History](https://agentx.sale/x402/polymarket-history?q=fed%20decision&days=7): YES-price time series over 1-90 days with change and high/low ($0.01)
- [Polymarket Resolution](https://agentx.sale/x402/polymarket-resolution?q=fed%20decision): did a market resolve, which outcome won, resolution source; bare call shows newest resolved ($0.01)
- [Polymarket Arb](https://agentx.sale/x402/polymarket-arb?limit=10): scans top-volume markets for YES+NO ask pairs under $1.00 ($0.01)

## Agent marketplace store

- [Store API](https://agentx.sale/api/services): the live marketplace catalogue (web extract, web search, site mapper, browser agent, batch scrape)
- [Health](https://agentx.sale/api/health): service health endpoint
- [Challenge](https://agentx.sale/challenge): agent verification gate
- [Services for humans](https://agentx.sale/services): human-readable service descriptions
